|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Dash In Rogue 10]] (version 2 of 4). This version has no document image of its own, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of this text ([[:File:VB6-113-Dash_In_Rogue_10-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]). Versions in date order: [[Dash In Rogue 10]] (original, release sheet of 4 September 2009); '''this page''' (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Dash In Rogue 10 (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); [[Dash In Rogue 10 (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Dash In Rogue 10]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Dash, who provides ability of 3. During battle, if with another T-47 and about to draw a battle destiny, may draw two and choose one. Immune to attrition < 4.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=14 Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; revised copy, PDF dated 20 April 2010), page 14, slip 113. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=14 Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Light Side, p. 52). Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[Dash In Rogue 10 (Errata 3)]]), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=52, page 52. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=52 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “113” at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “about to draw battle destiny” for “about to draw a battle destiny”: “May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Dash, who provides ability of 3. During battle, if with another T-47 and about to draw battle destiny, may draw two and choose one. Immune to attrition < 4.”<ref name="cl-1261_109-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Dash In Rogue 10 (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-dashinrogue10-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Dash In Rogue 10]]) again, word for word: “May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Dash, who provides ability of 3. During battle, if with another T-47 and about to draw a battle destiny, may draw two and choose one. Immune to attrition < 4.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual6-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual6-Light">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034714/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “113” at the bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Dash In Rogue 10 (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 52)<ref name="ml-ls" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Dash In Rogue 10]]) again, word for word: “May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Dash, who provides ability of 3. During battle, if with another T-47 and about to draw a battle destiny, may draw two and choose one. Immune to attrition < 4.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1261-109-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image print “113”).
|hatnote=For the original printed text, see [[Dash In Rogue 10]]. For the later versions, see [[Dash In Rogue 10 (Errata 2)]] (PC card image) and [[Dash In Rogue 10 (Errata 3)]] (Master List, the current text).
